title: Beware the Garden Snatch
description: A surreal night scene features two haloed angels with blue wings standing on a wooden platform, holding a small glowing heart between them. Above them floats a cracked moon-like orb containing multiple bee-like creatures with halos, an all-seeing eye with a sheep inside its pupil, and orange lightning. A wooden sign reads 'BEWARE THE GARDEN SNATCH' beside a path with footprints leading toward a dark city skyline.
